campaign.context: Over 400 Binance typosquat domains and typedream.app subpages spoof Ledger, Trezor, and Bybit via wallet-setup paths. Random-label bin* domains such as binancee2.com and biiusd.com form the bulk of the infrastructure alongside PaaS-hosted lure pages. Reporters phishunt_io and skocherhan flagged 403 IOCs between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-19.
campaign.name: Crypto phishing targeting Binance, Ledger, Trezor and Bybit
